Monthly rent is $1,450 due on the 1st. Security deposit: $1,450 equal to one month rent.
Late fee of $75 applies after a 5-day grace period. Returned payment fee of $35.
Tenant must provide 60 days written notice before move-out. Lease renews month-to-month unless 30 days notice given.
Tenant responsible for all utilities except water. Landlord may enter with 24 hours notice for repairs.
Maintenance requests must be submitted in writing within 48 hours of discovery.
